detailed_descriptions.en: You have been dispatched to a distant mountain chapel to do a simple job — inspect it and decide if it was worth preserving or if it was time for its final demolition. You were told it is in almost perfect condition. The shards of stained glass scattered across the floor suggest otherwise. Brush away the dust of centuries Pick up a dusty shard and brush the glass clean. Study its shape and color, compare it with the sketches on the altar, and carry it to its window. The right piece glides into its slot and turns to fit. Wrong guess? It simply sits crooked until you pull it back out. Bring the light back Restore six stained-glass windows from 2,655 shards. Finish a section and watch a golden shimmer sweep through the glass. Piece by piece, color, light and order return to the chapel. A little magic goes a long way Every time you place a shard correctly is a step closer to new upgrades. Choose your own path through all ten: reveal where a piece belongs, summon glass into your hand, carry a bigger stack, or let invisible fairies fly scattered shards home. The more you restore, the faster the work goes. Six windows, one quiet mystery Each window shows a scene from a glassmaker's life. Handwritten notes left around the chapel tell the rest, sometimes with a smile and sometimes with a sigh. Focus on the glass as you work — these windows hide more than meets the eye. And when the time comes, the final decision will be yours. Take your time There are no deadlines, penalties, or failures. Start with one window in Normal Mode and unlock the others as you go, or choose Hardcore Mode to have all six windows and their shards available from the start. Pause whenever you like, your progress gets saved automatically.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You have been dispatched to a distant mountain chapel to do a simple job — inspect it and decide if it was worth preserving or if it was time for its final demolition. You were told it is in almost perfect condition. The shards of stained glass scattered across the floor suggest otherwise.

Brush away the dust of centuries

Pick up a dusty shard and brush the glass clean. Study its shape and color, compare it with the sketches on the altar, and carry it to its window. The right piece glides into its slot and turns to fit. Wrong guess? It simply sits crooked until you pull it back out.

Bring the light back



Restore six stained-glass windows from 2,655 shards. Finish a section and watch a golden shimmer sweep through the glass. Piece by piece, color, light and order return to the chapel.

A little magic goes a long way



Every time you place a shard correctly is a step closer to new upgrades. Choose your own path through all ten: reveal where a piece belongs, summon glass into your hand, carry a bigger stack, or let invisible fairies fly scattered shards home. The more you restore, the faster the work goes.

Six windows, one quiet mystery

Each window shows a scene from a glassmaker's life. Handwritten notes left around the chapel tell the rest, sometimes with a smile and sometimes with a sigh. Focus on the glass as you work — these windows hide more than meets the eye. And when the time comes, the final decision will be yours.

Take your time

There are no deadlines, penalties, or failures. Start with one window in Normal Mode and unlock the others as you go, or choose Hardcore Mode to have all six windows and their shards available from the start. Pause whenever you like, your progress gets saved automatically.
